HomePage.aboutText: I've always been an entrepreneur at heart, and I started freelancing to satisfy my need to create. In addition to this change in status after nearly 4 years as an embedded software engineer, I want to focus more on frontend web development, which better aligns with my training, personal projects, and long-term ambitions. So here I am, in a way, among the juniors again, but with everything I've learned that I intend to transfer to this new position, just as I did in the reverse direction to succeed in my previous experience.

HomePage.story: Since I can remember, I have always had this inner desire to create my own projects. The choice of me going into computer science, at first, was somewhat random, but later turned out to be perfect for me to learn how to give life to ideas from almost nothing. I like to share my time between exploring my ideas, working with others and developing my other passions, notably bridge and music.
